fail_closed_reason: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: Heldout trip counts leak into formula selection, fewer than 20 route-hour rows are scored, source hashes drift, or the seasonal comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty.

incumbent_comparator.baseline_name: seasonal carry-forward and route-hour mean comparator
incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: predict each heldout route-hour count from last visible count and training-only route/hour mean
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: Implement a domain-specific scorer when this generic pack remains fail-closed.
no_fake_closure_policy: This pack is source-bound but cannot promote broad superiority unless actual target-hidden scoring materially beats the preregistered comparator.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: Acquire target-hidden source data, materialize OC and incumbent predictions, compute residuals, then rerun this pack and replay.

residual_requirement.formula: absolute count residual and Poisson deviance per route-hour

source.source_authority: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
source.source_name: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission Trip Record Data

target_variable.extraction_rule: Trip records are aggregated into a zone-hour flow panel; heldout hours and route counts remain sealed until graph-temporal predictions are written.
target_variable.name: heldout_zone_hour_trip_flow_count
target_variable.unit: trip records per pickup zone, dropoff zone, and hour

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute count residual and Poisson deviance per route-hour
uncertainty_requirement.rule: rolling training residual envelope with count-scale Poisson interval

why_it_failed: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.
